status: Exploratory design before stellar-library fitting to the DESI observations; existing band measurements and numerical reviews were already inspected.
question: Which formed-stellar-mass mixture ages remain compatible with the actual spectra of55 independently matched hosts, under explicitly finite stellar/dust/response/clock families?
sample: All55 distinct host spectra. No index-value, age, brightness, positivity or SNR cuts. Actual invalid/masked native pixels remain excluded by release semantics.

library.stellar_spectra: vacuum wavelengths, luminosity per solar mass formed, intrinsic R~3000 near4000A; this is not an infinite-resolution truth spectrum

mixtures: Nonnegative stellar coefficients, with no parametric SFH or shrinkage. Permit mixtures across all age/metallicity/dust columns. Formed-mass normalization excludes any free line-emission coefficients. This deliberately retains age-metallicity-differential-dust ambiguity.

dust.scope: Finite assumed attenuation families and hidden-mass support, not observed dust priors. No dust energy-balance constraint.

clock.primary: All library ages up to13.5Gyr at every redshift, deliberately independent of a fitted cosmological clock. This is a generous library-limited feasibility calculation, not a claim that13.5Gyr stars exist at high redshift.
clock.conditional: Repeat with age ceiling from flatLCDM H0=70km/s/Mpc,Omega_m=.3; label imposed clock, not information from these spectra. Interpolate a boundary SSP in log age as in the validated existing machinery.

observables.primary: Rebuild signed band fluxes from all native pixels and full5x5 formal covariance, preserving all overlap. Project same operators onto stellar spectra. Retain the original five-band vectors as a parallel diagnostic.
observables.emission_control: Before any fit, mask +/-400km/s around every FSPS-declared nebular emission line whose central wavelength lies within a used window. Use actual remaining pixel weights/covariance, without imputing masked line cores. Repeat +/-800km/s as sensitivity. This removes some stellar absorption information too; broadened emission outside masks remains a limitation.
observables.original_bands: Also fit original full bands with independent nonnegative emission amplitudes at those same line wavelengths; emission carries zero stellar formed mass. No Case-B or Cloudy line-ratio prior is silently imposed.

response.native: Retain original DESI diagonal resolution convention and do not normalize it silently; compare native convolution versus identity as a finite-resolution/model sensitivity. Intrinsic C3K_HR smoothing remains explicit. Validate row/column convention and broad-band changes.
response.continuum_tilt: Sensitivity exp(+/-0.02*(lambda_rest-4000)/100). These are prescribed response alternatives, not measured calibration errors.
response.camera_gain: For spectra spanning a camera join, vary adjacent-camera relative normalization by +/-3percent; no data-derived calibration prior.
response.foreground: Forward F99 Rv3.1 on observed wavelengths using native DESI EBV times0.86; compare scale1.0. Released spectra are not already MW dereddened.

likelihood: Signed Gaussian band-flux likelihood with full5x5 covariance from native diagonal IVAR. Whiten before nonnegative fitting. Known DESI calibration, interpixel covariance and coadd-resolution issues remain outside formal errors.
bounds: Absolute95percent Gaussian mean-flux ellipsoid (chi-square quantile with observed vector rank) and nonnegative mixture age extrema. Generalized Charnes-Cooper SOCP with stellar-mass denominator; no degrees-of-freedom subtraction. Dual and original-unit primal checks required. Not Bayesian age posteriors.
discrepancy_sensitivity: Add an assumed independent3percent relative per-band discrepancy in quadrature, labelled compatibility only because its covariance depends on observed flux and is not calibrated. Keep formal-noise model failures visible.
validation: Pin source/build/data/code identities and all55 IDs
Verify native DESI resolution-diagonal convention independently
Whitened objective equals direct full-covariance quadratic
Independent primal endpoint checks on deterministic cases
Synthetic pure/mixture spectra and explicit zero-flux cases
Age/metallicity refinement on deterministic subset chosen by ID hash
No silent numerical failures or selected exclusion of incompatible spectra
limits: Fibre stellar populations, not global/progenitor ages. Finite stellar-library, IMF, abundance, metallicity, dust and clock assumptions are not empirically validated by a fit. No brightness coefficient, population transport, grey correction or cosmological result follows.
